raj.platform: FYI I ran into a weird edge-only issue: after bundling our JS SDK with Vite for an edge target the Authorization header disappears from outgoing SDK requests. app-level auth code works unbundled. leaving notes here so others can try. :mag:

raj.platform: quick repro steps I used:
1) tiny edge handler that imports the SDK and calls inference client
2) build with Vite SSR bundle (target esnext, default esbuild transform)
3) deploy to edge preview; requests reach the handler but the downstream fetch from the SDK has no Authorization header
4) SDK retry loop kicks in (401s) and it looks like token resolution never ran

raj.platform: sample package.json (minimal):
```json
{
  "name": "edge-sdk-vite-repro",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": { "@redwood/inference-sdk": "^0.0.0" }
}
```

raj.platform: vite config I used:
```js
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
export default defineConfig({
  build: { ssr: true, target: 'esnext' },
  optimizeDeps: { esbuildOptions: { target: 'es2020' } }
})
```

liam-eng: do you see the header in dev mode (unbundled)?

raj.platform: yes — in dev server the SDK sends Authorization: Bearer <token>. after I run `vite build` and deploy the bundle, the outgoing fetch only has Content-Type. looked at the compiled bundle and noticed the SDK import was wrapped.

raj.platform: snippet from the built server bundle (dist/handler.js):
```js
const sdk = require('@redwood/inference-sdk');
// later
const headers = Object.assign({}, sdk.default?.auth?.getRequestHeaders?.() || {});
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers });
```

nora.docs: that require() + sdk.default smell is classic CJS/ESM interop. esbuild/rollup sometimes emit __esModule wrappers and consumers end up reading .default.

taylor-sdk: thanks for the repro — two followups: (1) we should make our runtime resilient to both module shapes; (2) update package.json exports so bundlers pick the correct entrypoints. I'll open a patch.

liam-eng: I tried Rollup with commonjs plugin and hit similar wrapping; Webpack (module type set to 'es6') preserved named exports so it worked there. Vite's esbuild transform was the most frequent offender.

raj.platform: workaround that fixed my Vite builds locally: in vite.config set `build.commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules = true` and also set env `VITE_SSR_NO_EXTERNAL=true`. That prevented the default-wrapping and restored headers. not ideal for customers though.

ci-bot: build:edge-samples #2187765432 started  running matrix: vite/rollup/webpack. ETA ~12m.

taylor-sdk: proposed runtime guard (pseudocode):
```js
const loaded = await import(modPath);
const resolved = (loaded && loaded.__esModule) ? loaded.default : loaded;
const authPlugin = resolved.auth || resolved.default?.auth || null;
```
That avoids relying on bundler output. Also adding package.json exports like:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }
},
"types": "dist/esm/index.d.ts"
```
should make bundlers choose correct format and keep typings intact.

nora.docs: please add a short note in onboarding docs and sample-app README about Vite SSR flags + exports map; many customers use Vite for edge functions and this will save support time.

raj.platform: logs from the failing edge deployment: 
[2026-03-16T14:03:11Z] ERROR inference: request failed status=401 token=missing auth_attempt=1
[2026-03-16T14:03:11Z] ERROR inference: auth refresh attempted -> 401
[2026-03-16T14:03:12Z] WARN retry: backoff=150ms
[2026-03-16T14:03:13Z] ERROR inference: request failed status=401 token=missing auth_attempt=2

liam-eng: opened an internal ticket documenting edge bundler quirks + recommended build flags. will collect repro links.

taylor-sdk: PR #501 opened with: runtime safe-import fix, exports map + types, and a small test harness that runs a headless bundler matrix asserting auth headers in a local edge-like runner. Marked for patch release.

ci-bot: build:edge-samples #2187765432 finished b results: vite: fail (auth header removed), rollup: fail (default wrapper), webpack: pass. Artifacts uploaded.

raj.platform: thanks all. I'll push the mini repro repo and link it in the ticket. also happy to help update the onboarding guide with the Vite tip. keep posting similar cases here if you hit other bundlers or plugin combos.
